parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no member records (`"members": []`) and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `shared_ancestor`) are null. Without any field-level or method-level evidence to compare, the only signal is the cluster_id string itself, which names two distinct error types — `PlaycutMetadataService.MetadataError` in `Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/PlaycutMetadataService.swift` and `HTTPStreamError` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/MP3Streamer/Streaming/HTTPStreamClient.swift` — that belong to unrelated domain concerns (metadata lookup vs. HTTP streaming). Structural coincidence between two error enums in separate packages is a canonical coincidental-shape match, not a refactor opportunity. No action is warranted until member-level evidence is available.
